segments.text: The gels are then removed from the falcon tubes, and then placed in a single falcon tube, 15 milliliter falcon tube, with 5 milliliters of one x bar for solution.
This one X buffer W solution was made by producing 45 milliliters of water with 5 milliliters of buffer W solution.
This is then placed in an orbital shaker for 15 minutes, and then we'll be shaken five times at 70 RPM.
